Setup the covariate matrix for the forest plot data <- data.table::fread(ffemData) dfCovsForest <- PMXForest::createInputForestData(     PMXForest::getCovStats(data,cov_names$orgCovNames,probs=c(0.05,0.9),missVal=-99),     iMiss    =-99   )  # 2. Define the parameter function (No ETAs needed for the forest plot) funcList_forest <- list(   function(basethetas, covthetas, dfrow, ...) {      basethetas[2] * exp(covthetas[1])    } )  # 3. Get bootstrap samples for uncertainty extFile <- file.path(modDevDir, "run31.ext") bsFile  <- file.path(modDevDir, "bs31.dir/raw_results_run31.csv")  set.seed(123) samples <- PMXForest::getSamples(bsFile, extFile = extFile, n = 25)  # 4. text: Predictive performance must also simulated using FFEM model simulations condition actual observed covariates. use pre-computed vpctab31 generated FFEM model.
code: ## VPC configuration n_bins     <- 8 vpc_q      <- c(p10 = 0.10, p50 = 0.50, p90 = 0.90) ci_q       <- c(lower = 0.05, median = 0.50, upper = 0.95) vpc_colors <- c(p10 = "#005B65", p50 = "#E1A178", p90 = "#005B65")  calculate_bins <- . %>%   group_by(time_bin) %>%   summarise(     x_time = median(TAD),     p10 = quantile(DV, probs = vpc_q["p10"]),     p50 = quantile(DV, probs = vpc_q["p50"]),     p90 = quantile(DV, probs = vpc_q["p90"]),     .groups = "drop" # Suppress grouping messages   )  # Read the VPC data vpctab <- read.table(file.path(modDevDir, "vpctab31"), skip = 1, header = TRUE)  ## Process simulated data vpc_sim_summary <- vpctab %>%   filter(TAD != 0) %>%   mutate(DV = exp(DV), time_bin = cut_number(TAD, n = n_bins)) %>%   group_by(REPI) %>%   nest() %>%   mutate(binned = purrr::map(data, calculate_bins)) %>%   unnest(binned) %>%   pivot_longer(     cols = starts_with("p"),      names_to = "percentile",      values_to = "value"   ) %>%   # Calculate confidence intervals across replicates   group_by(time_bin, x_time, percentile) %>%   summarise(     lower = quantile(value, probs = ci_q["lower"]),     upper = quantile(value, probs = ci_q["upper"]),     .groups = "drop"   )  # Process observed data vpc_obs_summary <- ffem_tab %>%   filter(TAD != 0) %>%   mutate(DV = exp(DV), time_bin = cut_number(TAD, n = n_bins)) %>%   calculate_bins() %>%   pivot_longer(     cols = starts_with("p"),      names_to = "percentile",      values_to = "value")  ## Type 2 (\(\eta\) Samples): Uses \(\eta\) samples integrates observed FFEM covariates. Useful model contains non-FREM covariates. title: PMXFrem 2.0.0
text: Create FREM models: Added createFREMmodel(), robust function FREM model generation can replace PsNs frem command. Added keepDoseOnlySubjects toggle across pipeline allow retention subjects without PK observations (defaults FALSE legacy compatibility). Unified Parameter Engine: Refactored fremParameterTable() guarantee base parameters covariate coefficients derived exact bootstrap sample space. Covariate Coefficient Tables: Added coefficientTable_long (API-ready) coefficientTable_wide (document-ready) outputs. Dynamic Uncertainty Formatting: Added uncertainty ("RSE" "CI"), ciLevel, sigDigs arguments fremParameterTable() trailing zero preservation (%#). Covariate Label Generator: Added generateCovNames() dynamic/interactive Forest Plot label generation. Integrated Shrinkage Reporting: fremParameterTable() now natively reports parameter shrinkages via includeShrinkage = TRUE ffemModName arguments. Users can control reported metric (shrinkageType), decimal precision (shkDigs), choose report raw mathematical values NONMEM-style floored values (rawShrinkage). New Features: Added diagnostic plotting functions plotEtasCov() plotCovDist(). plotEtasCov() creates faceted scatter plots compare FREM ETAs, ETA_PRIMs, FFEM EBEs covariates. plotCovDist() generates distribution plots estimated covariates. automatically visualize group data based original covariate missingness. New Vignettes: Added Tier 1 (quick-start.Rmd) Tier 2 (walk-.Rmd) workflows. Deep-dive vignettes createFREMmodel, standard diagnostics, forest plots, explained variability plots updateFREMmodel.

title: PMXFrem 2.0.0
text: Modularized Variance Engines: monolithic getExplainedVar.R script completely decoupled. Delta Rule approximation (type=0) empirical variance evaluations (type=1,2,3) now isolated pure, standalone helper functions within R/utils-getExplainedVar.R. Eradicated rbind Memory Leaks: Completely removed iterative rbind dplyr::bind_rows calls inside deep ETA sampling permutation loops getExplainedVar(). Data frames now accumulated via pre-allocated lists bound exactly per execution block, removing exponential memory reallocation drastically reducing execution time large pharmacometric cohorts. Removed Regex AST Hacks: Eliminated computationally expensive brittle jxrtp47 string replacement loop. FFEM expressions now natively securely evaluated using isolated environment scoping (eval(..., envir = list(data = datatmp))).

title: PMXFrem 2.0.0
text: Stable Dataset Sorting: Output datasets now automatically sorted using stable index (ORIG_ROW_IDX) FREMTYPE protect intra-subject sequences. cstrSortCols argument updateFREMmodel deprecated safely ignored warning. Strict Covariate Validation: ensure data hygiene, dichotomous covariates coded 1/2 now trigger validation error default. Legacy PsN compatibility can maintained explicitly setting allowNon01 = TRUE bRecodeDichotomous = TRUE. API Cleanup: Internal pipeline functions (e.g., augmentFremData, prepareAndValidateData) moved internal namespace declutter user-facing API.

title: PMXFrem 2.0.0
text: Covariate Cross-Contamination (TOTCOVVAR Anomaly): Fixed critical regex bug (length(grepl(...))) missing data mapping function caused covariates overlapping substrings (e.g., AGE PAGE) incorrectly overwritten -99. resolves anomaly TOTCOVVAR artificially suppressed COVVAR due valid data silently dropped. Windows PSOCK Parallelization: Resolved “Object found” crashes Windows machines using ncores > 1 getExplainedVar(). isolating empirical variance engine, local environment now explicitly bundled exported (.export = c(ls(environment()), ...)) foreach workers, bypassing fragile static code analysis. Orphaned Cluster Teardown: Parallel backend clusters getExplainedVar() now safely terminated via .exit(doParallel::stopImplicitCluster(), add = TRUE) handler, preventing memory locks variance calculation throws fatal error. Lazy-Evaluation Signature Traps: Removed dependencies dfext default arguments getExplainedVar() function signature (e.g., numFREMThetas, numSigmas). now explicitly calculated function body dfext validated, preventing silent scoping crashes. SD Scale Transformation: Fixed fremParameterTable() logic SD transformations occur CI/RSE calculations, ensuring uncertainties match reported scale. ETA Mismatch EV: Fixed longitudinal subsetting (!duplicated(data[[strID]])) prevent ETA length mismatches getExplainedVar(). Missing Covariate Failsafe: Added explicit stop() errors missing categorical covariates getExplainedVar(). NSE Scoping data.table: Fixed j symbol scoping errors coercing inputs base data.frame strict drop=FALSE subsetting variance calculations. Exact List Extraction: Replaced bracket subsetting [[cov]][1] fix vulnerability dummy column mapping.
